<a id="the-laws-of-one-step--一步的规律"></a>
# The laws of one step

<!-- Generated by tools/research/registry.py; edit the matching JSON record. -->

`laws-of-one-step` · **recorded-checked** · theorem · F01 · [record](laws-of-one-step.json) · [register](../../../../RESULTS.md)

> Each law holds of every world, with the condition its proof uses stated inside it as a fact about that world at the steps and relata used: balance at a step fixes coming to stand and ceasing to stand, running down fixes and bounds change, and a list covering what holds ties ceasing to arising.

<a id="laws--规律"></a>
## Laws

1. Balance at a step: the flow balances on a family across a step where each member's level after it, with what was taken from it, is its level before with what was given to it; balance is balance on every family across every step. (`Becoming.Flow.BalancesOn`, `Becoming.Flow.balances_iff_on`)
2. With balance at a condition across a step, it comes to stand exactly when it stood at nothing and was given more than was taken from it, and ceases to stand exactly when it stood and what was taken from it is all it had with all it was given. (`Becoming.Flow.BalancesOn.comesToStand_iff`, `Becoming.Flow.BalancesOn.ceasesToStand_iff`)
3. Across a step at which nothing is taken from a balanced family, a member rises exactly when something taking part gives to it, which dissipation on the family excludes. (`Becoming.Flow.BalancesOn.rises_iff_gives`, `Becoming.Flow.DissipatesOn.still_untaken`)
4. Arising needs an active giver: a relatum embodied at both ends of the step and given to only by active formations arises exactly when it comes to stand, so as an active giver other than itself gives to it. (`Becoming.Flow.BalancesOn.arises_iff`, `Becoming.Flow.BalancesOn.arises_given`)
5. Nothing comes to stand from nothing across a step at which a family holding it is balanced and dissipated on. (`Becoming.Flow.BalancesOn.comes_from_standing`)
6. Rest: a family runs down across a step where it holds, without repetition, whatever stands before or after the step, and the flow balances and dissipates on it, with no closure; then some condition's standing changes exactly when the family's total falls, and, with the family closed, something taking part takes or gives exactly then. (`Becoming.Flow.RunsDownOn`, `Becoming.Flow.RunsDownOn.changes_iff`, `Becoming.Flow.RunsDownOn.exchanges_iff`)
7. Continued change needs openness, exactly: under a census of what stands, standing changes at arbitrarily late steps exactly when it changes at arbitrarily late steps across which what stands does not run down, and so with the exchange and closure. (`Becoming.Flow.change_recurs_iff`, `Becoming.Flow.exchange_recurs_iff`)
8. The general form of recurrence: where under a condition an event lowers an amount, the amount never rises under the condition, and every rise of it is the event, the event recurs exactly where it recurs without the condition, by a bounded search with no decision. (`Becoming.recurs_iff_unmet`)
9. Running down bounds change: over any stretch, with no condition, what stands at its end with the steps at which the total standing fell number at most the total at its start with all it rose. (`Becoming.Flow.standing_bounds_change`)
10. The total rises only across steps that do not run down, so across steps that run down what stands at the end with the steps at which some standing changed is within the total at the start, with no decision of whether a standing changed. (`Becoming.Flow.runsDown_bounds_change`, `Becoming.Flow.runsDown_change_bound`)
11. Ceasing needs arising: a list covers what holds at a step where every member holding there is on it; for any finite list, what holds of it at the end of a stretch with its ceasings is what held of it at the start exactly when none of it comes to be across the stretch. (`Becoming.Covers`, `Becoming.cohort_closes_iff`)
12. With a list holding exactly what holds at N and nothing coming to be after N, what holds at the end with what ceased since N number exactly those holding at N. (`Becoming.ListsAt`, `Becoming.ceasing_needs_arising`)
13. Ceasing recurring needs coming to be recurring wherever some list covers what holds at arbitrarily late steps, a census being the case of covering every step. (`Becoming.coming_of_ceasing_covered`, `Becoming.Listed.covered`)
14. With no decision, where a list covers step N and nothing comes to be after it, ceasing does not recur. (`Becoming.Covers.ceasing_not_recurring`, `Becoming.Covers.not_not_coming_from`)
15. Corollaries: a premise selected for every step makes each condition hold everywhere, so the selection results follow, their statements unchanged and their proofs through these laws: the openness module's rest theorems, the premises supplying the condition, ceasing needing arising for worlds and standing censuses, the active giver of an embodied relatum, and the enclosure and binding laws of counting and standing. (`Becoming.Flow.change_stops_unrefuted_around`, `Becoming.Flow.exchange_not_recurring_around`, `Becoming.Flow.standing_never_rises`, `Becoming.Flow.change_lowers`, `Becoming.Flow.AroundStanding.runsDownClosed`, `Becoming.World.arising_of_ceasing`, `Becoming.Web.StandingCensus.coming_of_ceasing`, `Becoming.Web.Embodied.arises_given`, `Becoming.World.enclosure_bounds_change`, `Becoming.World.taking_binds_counting`, `Becoming.World.enclosed_binds_counting`, `Becoming.World.enclosure_bounds_standing`, `Becoming.World.enclosed_binds_standing`)

<a id="conditions--条件"></a>
## Conditions

- No global premise: the condition of each law is stated inside it, as a fact about the world at the steps and relata where the proof uses it (balance and dissipation on a family across a step, the embodiment of a relatum, a list at some steps).
- A census of what stands: the recurrence laws and running down bounding change use it, only to make the total standing a number at each step; it is a local condition at the steps of a tail, not a global premise. The laws of one step need no census.
- Representation: discrete steps and natural-number amounts; the least difference in dissipation (the sign term, Ren's option A), which the recurrence of continued change and the bounds on change use; the exact count of ceasing needing arising uses marks (deciding what holds), its form that ceasing does not recur none. These are commitments of the representation, not premises on worlds.

<a id="does-not-show--未表明"></a>
## Does not show

- No premise is derived: the move is localization, not a re-founding of the representation, within which the premises remain contingent and independent.
- Running down bounds change by an inequality, not an iff; the exact form is the identity over a stretch together with the one-step iffs.
- The recurrence laws and the bound need a census of what stands at the steps of a tail; dropping it where infinitely many stand would change the representation of amounts, a decision outside this result.
- Whether each law survives amounts finer than whole units: laws-at-finer-units gives it, law 1's recurrence and law 3's bound needing the refinement counted as a giving; for rest, the resolution result covers it.
- Coarser steps are in laws-at-coarser-steps and the tower of discrete readings in continuous-time-as-tower; real-valued time is not formalized.
- Closure is not what bounds change: the proof shows that running down does, closure being how the premises supply it; the name ‘closure bounds change’ is Ren's.
- **Counterexample:** World.sourcedQueue: the flow balances and is dissipative (which binds only closed families), yet members come to stand from nothing; by Flow.BalancesOn.comes_from_standing no family holding such a member is dissipated on across that step. So the local condition is dissipation on a family holding the relatum, which the premise supplies only where that family is closed. [source](../../../../experiments/integrated-correction/general-framework/generative-basis/lean/becoming/Becoming/Standing.lean)
- **Counterexample:** Listed.lpo_of_few: the form in which ceasing does not recur needs no decision, but naming an explicit last step needs omniscience in general; so continued change needing openness and ceasing needing arising are stated as negated recurrences. [source](../../../../experiments/integrated-correction/general-framework/generative-basis/lean/becoming/Becoming/Openness.lean)

**Standard boundaries:** No ethical premise and no Lean axiom is used. · Contains no ethical predicate and evaluates neither arising nor ceasing. · Stated for discrete steps. · Names follow the structural naming criteria and are adopted only where the statement has their exact meaning; readings are interpretations, open to revision.

<a id="correspondence--对应"></a>
### Correspondence

The selection theorems ask which laws the counts obey under a selection of the eight premises. Following Ren's redirect, this result asks instead what each law needs, at which steps and relata of the world. The proofs show the conditions are local: the laws of one step use balance only at that step and condition; rest uses only a family holding what stands running down across those steps, with no closure; running down bounds the change of what stands with no embodiment; ceasing needs arising uses only a list covering what holds, with no census. Where the premises hold at every step, these conditions hold at every step, so the selection results are corollaries. Reading (AI, adopted on Ren's delegation): the laws of Part I that the premises bound are laws of each step and its relata, and the premises are one way of making their conditions hold everywhere.
